description: cua-lite preprocessed version of OpenBMB/CAGUI. Chinese-language Android mobile dataset contributing understanding (UI-element functional captioning + OCR, region-conditioned) and use (multi-step agent demonstrations across Chinese apps such as Eleme, WeChat, NetEase Music).
extra_notes: First Chinese-only dataset in cua-lite (metadata.others.language = "zh"). Use rows preserve the upstream per-step ui_positions (all on-screen element boxes) under metadata.others.ui_positions, converted to [0, 1000] [x1, y1, x2, y2].
